question: How was the teaching transmitted among the earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: The recipients are earth-moving yoginīs described as good eaters
inference: The teaching was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The form bhūcarī as instrumental singular is unusual and may reflect textual variation
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
